info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Operation Trade Confirmation Matchings-spec
info.description: The Market Operation Trade Confirmation Matchings API provides a streamlined interface for retrieving trade confirmation matchings associated with market operations. This endpoint serves as a resource for financial institutions and trading platforms looking to validate and reconcile trades in an efficient manner. By accessing this API, users can obtain detailed information about confirmed matches, enhancing operational accuracy and compliance. Typical consumers include traders, compliance officers, and financial analysts seeking to monitor trade confirmations and related match activities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve trade confirmation matches from the market operations. It provides a streamlined way to access data related to trade confirmations, facilitating faster reconciliation and auditing processes.
